The land belonging to the petitioner had already been acquired under the National Highways Act for expansion of road project.
The grievances of the writ petitioner is that the compensation determined is yet to be settled in her favour.

2.The representation submitted by the writ petitioner in this regard was responded by stating that a civil suit in O.S.No.48 of 2017 is pending on the file of the District Munsif Court at Kancheepuram District.

entities.text: District Munsif Court at Kancheepuram District

sentences.text: During the pendency of the suit, the authorities may not be in a position to settle the c o m p e n s a t i o n i n f a v o u r o f t h e p e t i t i o n e r , s i n c e t h e r e i s a r i v a l c l a i m a n t .
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
The issues in this regard are to be resolved between the parties for settlement of compensation awarded under the land acquisition proceedings.
However, there is no impediment for the respondents to deposit the compensation in the Court more specifically in the pending suit in OS.No.48 of 2017.

3.That being the factum, the respondents are directed to deposit the compensation in the Court accounts, enabling the parties to withdraw the same after resolving the issues by following the procedures as contemplated.
4.With these directions, the writ petition stands disposed of.
However, there shall be no order as to costs.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
